name: sweeploom
description: Local-first workstation cleaner: inspect disk, sessions, and AI stores; apply only after review.

interface.shortDescription: Reclaim a workstation without losing chat context
interface.longDescription: SweepLoom is a Weavatrix product. It maps disk, processes, projects, and AI stores locally, then deletes only reviewed SAFE generated rows. Live agents stay Keep. Apply through MCP requires confirm=true.
defaultPrompt: Use SweepLoom to list cleanup_candidates for this repo and explain anything unclear. Do not apply yet.
Use SweepLoom to list_ai_stores and show always-on token tax. Do not park AGENTS.md or rules.
Use SweepLoom to list_sessions. Do not terminate live agents.
